descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S02 Existing specs: a network drop at Generate shows an explicit failure and keeps the dictation, a second tap gives the real note (both contexts); the no-network banner comes and goes (S13 merged here)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style (TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 1)
  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear 'no network' message; dictation kept and retried when the connection returns, so dropped hospital Wi-Fi does not lose a physician's dictation (UAT Empty & Failure States (Offline / no network); UAT OAT-03 Source; TFA-94745 state 9)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium fixtures: a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident; the first ai/notes:generateNote request is rejected at the Convex socket before the model call (action-observer failFirst); the second goes to the configured model; for the banner, a signed-in Hospital list (Morning Rounds)

When Type the encounter dictation, tap Generate Note & Finish, then tap it again; for the banner, context.setOffline(true), then setOffline(false)

Then First tap: an inline message that the dictation is saved and the note couldn't be generated, with Generate Note & Finish still offered; the box and the server still hold the dictation and no note is stored. Second tap: the real note is rendered and saved, the dictation unchanged, and it survives a reload. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Proves explicit failure + kept input + a manual retry for a client-to-server drop, in both contexts. It does not show an automatic retry (Q1), and the copy is not the literal 'Note not generated' (Q3). The second tap calls the configured model (the spec is not E2E_AI_LIVE gated). The banner test (former S13) is the Hospital list only; …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94422 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

Nothing a physician would see: Tim's SNF note-generation spec times out because its fixture has no rawPreRoundNotes, so the stale-pre-round check added on 09-24 keeps Generate disabled; the other three specs pass.

Evidence: allure 222b26d6-…-result.json; matrix/OAT-03.results.json, lane A. note-generation.spec.ts:248 is one of the six test out of date results: the 240 s timeout is caused by Vikram's 3878afa (09-24) stale check. It has been red since 09-24; bisecting 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248 on the isolated stack showed no regression. connection-banner, encounter-workflow and the Hospital note-generation spec are as expected.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).
